facts.fact: NITA-U contracted CITCC on 2022-04-22 (NITA-U/Supplies/21-22/001) to supply, install and commission NBI/EGI Phase V, extending the backbone to about 62 districts; Hansard of 2023-12-06 says implementation was expected to start early 2024.
facts.system: National Data Transmission Backbone Infrastructure Phase V

facts.fact: ICT Minister Baryomunsi told Parliament on 2023-12-06 that existing NBI coverage was about 50 per cent of the country, with roughly 62 districts not covered by phases I-IV.
